lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 9 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is denser in the anterior region and widens significantly towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcations observed at the dorsal origin of the third and fifth lines, where segments merge or split near the spinal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 6, and 8 are truncated, terminating mid-torso before reaching the ventral fringe; line 4 displays a pixel-level gap in the mid-section.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density; two distinct high-contrast white circular spots are visible on the upper posterior haunch, separated by a wide spatial gap.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a spiral rotation; the silhouette follows an outward-lateral arc from the base before converging medially at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The horizontal distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-toned tips comprise roughly the upper 12 percent of the total vertical horn structure length.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the ocular regions; dual white spots on the lower facial mandible; prominent white 'sock' banding on all four distal limbs.
